blocks.text: -ing bilan boshlanadigan qism (-ing clause) — ikkinchi gapning qisqargan shakli: She sat by the window. She was reading a book. → She sat by the window **reading** a book. Bu gapni ixcham va ravon qiladi, ayniqsa hikoya va yangiliklarda. Asosiy shart: -ing harakatini bajaruvchi asosiy gapning **egasi** bilan **bir xil** bo'lishi kerak. O'zbek tilida bunga ravishdoshlar juda mos keladi: «-ib» (kitob **o'qib** o'tirdi), «-yotib» (**o'ynayotib** yiqildi), «-gach» (ishni **tugatgach**), «-gani uchun» (**charchagani uchun**). Bu darsda uch ma'no: bir vaqtdagi harakat, ketma-ket harakat va sabab.
1. Bir vaqtda: She sat reading a book

Ikki harakat **bir paytda** sodir bo'lsa: Tom came into the room **carrying** a huge box — Tom katta quti **ko'tarib** xonaga kirdi. Ko'pincha sit, stand, lie, come, go, walk fe'llaridan keyin. Shu guruhga yana bir holat kiradi: bir harakat **boshqasi davom etayotgan paytda** sodir bo'ladi (ko'pincha kutilmagan hodisa): He hurt his back **lifting** a heavy suitcase = **while he was lifting** — Og'ir chamadonni **ko'tarayotib** belini shikastladi. Bu ma'noda **while / when + -ing** ham keladi: Be careful **when crossing** the road; I met Kate **while travelling** in Scotland.

items.text: Grandpa sat in the garden **reading** the newspaper.
Jasur cut his finger **opening** a tin of tomatoes.
items.translation: Jasur pomidor konservasini **ochayotib** barmog'ini kesib oldi.

blocks.text: 2. Ketma-ket: Opening the door, ... / Having finished, ...

Bir harakat **tugagach** ikkinchisi boshlansa, birinchisini -ing bilan aytish mumkin: **Taking** a key out of her bag, she opened the door — Sumkasidan kalitni **olib**, eshikni ochdi. Ketma-ketlikni aniqroq ko'rsatish kerak bo'lsa yoki birinchi harakat biroz vaqt olgan bo'lsa — **having + V3**: **Having finished** her work, she went home — Ishini **tugatgach**, uyiga ketdi. Bu «After she had finished ...» ning qisqasi (→ 15-dars). **After / before + -ing** ham keng ishlatiladi (→ 60-dars): **After finishing** her work, ...

rows: **Not knowing** the way, we got lost.

items.text: **Locking** the door behind him, Aziz walked to the car.
items.translation: Eshikni ortidan **qulflab**, Aziz mashina tomon yurdi.

items.text: **Having checked** all the windows, we went to bed.
**After graduating** from university, Kate worked in Manchester.

blocks.text: 3. Sabab: Feeling tired, I went to bed

-ing qismi **sababni** ham bildiradi — «...gani uchun», «...gani sababli»: **Feeling** tired, I went to bed early = Because I felt tired, ... Ko'pincha holat fe'llari bilan: **being** (Being a doctor, she knew what to do), **knowing**, **having**, **thinking**, **hoping**, **wanting**, **living**. Sabab avvalroq bo'lgan ish bo'lsa — **having + V3**: **Having lived** in London for years, Bekzod speaks excellent English. Inkorda **not** -ing dan oldin turadi: **Not having** a car, we took the bus. Bunday gaplar rasmiyroq va yozma uslubga xos; og'zaki nutqda ko'pincha **because / as** ishlatiladi.

rows: **Feeling** hungry, we stopped at a café.
**Being** a student, I get a discount.
**Having seen** the film, I knew the ending.
Because I had seen the film, ...
**Not wanting** to wake her, I left quietly.
Because I didn't want to wake her, ...

items.text: **Being** the oldest child, Dilnoza helped her mother a lot.
items.translation: Oilaning eng katta farzandi **bo'lgani uchun** Dilnoza onasiga ko'p yordam berardi.

items.text: **Not knowing** what to say, Tom just smiled.
**Having lost** his passport, James couldn't fly home.
items.translation: Pasportini **yo'qotib qo'ygani uchun** Jeyms uyiga ucha olmadi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) «osilib qolgan» -ing — egalar mos kelmaydi: «**Walking** to work, the rain started» — go'yo yomg'ir ishga ketyapti! To'g'ri: **Walking** to work, **I** got caught in the rain / **While I was walking** to work, it started to rain. (2) ortiqcha bog'lovchi: «Because being tired, I ...» → **Being** tired, I ... yoki **Because I was** tired, ... (3) having dan keyin V3 shart: «Having finish» → **Having finished**. (4) inkor joyi: «Having not money» → **Not having** any money. (5) -ing qismini yolg'iz qoldirish: «Feeling tired.» — to'liq gap emas; **Feeling tired, I went to bed.**

O'zbekcha ravishdosh bilan solishtiring: «-ib» / «-yotib» — **-ing**; «-gach», «...dan keyin» — **having + V3** yoki **after -ing**; «-gani uchun» — **-ing** / **being** / **having + V3**; «-may», «-magani uchun» — **not -ing**. Va doim tekshiring: -ing harakatini kim bajaryapti? Asosiy gapning egasimi?

Otdan keyin keladigan -ing va -ed (the woman **talking** to Tom, the man **injured** in the accident) — boshqa hodisa, ular aniqlovchi vazifasida: → 97-dars. Majhul shakl ham mumkin (→ 43-dars): **Having been told** the news, she phoned her sister — Xabarni **eshitgach**, opasiga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

items: Bir vaqtdagi harakat: She came in **smiling**. — U **jilmayib** kirdi.
Harakat davomida: He slipped **running** for the bus. — Avtobusga **yugurayotib** toyib ketdi.
Ketma-ket harakat: **Opening** the letter, she read it twice. — Xatni **ochib**, ikki marta o'qidi.
Avval tugagan harakat: **Having finished** the report, he left. — Hisobotni **tugatgach**, ketdi.
Sabab: **Being** busy, I couldn't call. — **Band bo'lganim uchun** qo'ng'iroq qila olmadim.
Inkor sabab: **Not having** time, we skipped lunch. — **Vaqtimiz bo'lmagani uchun** tushlik qilmadik.

examples.title: Same time: **sat reading**, **came in carrying**
examples.description: Ikki harakat bir vaqtda: asosiy fe'l + -ing — «-ib», «-gancha». Ko'pincha sit, stand, lie, come, walk bilan.

sentences.text: Madina spent the whole evening on the sofa **watching** old Uzbek films.
sentences.translation: Madina butun kechqurunni divanda eski o'zbek filmlarini **tomosha qilib** o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: Tom came into the office **carrying** a huge box of doughnuts.
sentences.translation: Tom ofisga katta quti donut **ko'tarib** kirdi.

sentences.text: The children ran out of school **laughing** and **shouting**.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **kulib, qiy-chuv ko'tarib** maktabdan yugurib chiqishdi.

sentences.text: Grandma stood at the gate **waving** until our car disappeared.
sentences.translation: Buvim mashinamiz ko'zdan g'oyib bo'lguncha darvoza oldida **qo'l silkitib** turdi.

sentences.text: Don't lie in bed all morning **scrolling** through your phone!
sentences.translation: Ertalab bo'yi telefoningni **varaqlab** to'shakda yotma!

sentences.text: Bekzod walked home in the rain, **thinking** about what the doctor had said.
sentences.translation: Bekzod shifokorning gaplari haqida **o'ylagancha** yomg'irda uyiga piyoda qaytdi.

sentences.text: A young man was sitting next to me **talking** loudly on his phone.
sentences.translation: Yonimda bir yigit telefonda baland ovozda **gaplashib** o'tirardi.

sentences.text: Emma left the room, **slamming** the door behind her.
sentences.translation: Emma eshikni ortidan **qarsillatib yopib**, xonadan chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: Several tourists were standing outside the mosque **taking** photos.
sentences.translation: Bir necha sayyoh masjid tashqarisida **suratga olib** turishardi.

sentences.text: Kate drove to Oxford **listening** to an audiobook about Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Keyt Samarqand haqidagi audiokitobni **tinglab** Oksfordga mashinada bordi.

examples.title: During another action: **hurt his knee playing**
examples.description: Bir harakat boshqasi davom etayotganda sodir bo'ladi (ko'pincha kutilmagan hodisa): -ing yoki while / when + -ing — «-yotib», «-yotganda».

sentences.text: Aziz hurt his knee **playing** football with his colleagues.
sentences.translation: Aziz hamkasblari bilan futbol **o'ynayotib** tizzasini lat yedi.

sentences.text: Be careful **when crossing** the road near the school.
sentences.translation: Maktab yaqinida yo'ldan **o'tayotganda** ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: Sarah lost her ring **swimming** in the sea.
sentences.translation: Sara dengizda **suzayotib** uzugini yo'qotib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: I met my future wife **while working** as a volunteer in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bo'lajak xotinim bilan Buxoroda ko'ngilli bo'lib **ishlayotganimda** tanishdim.

sentences.text: Did you burn yourself **taking** the tray out of the oven?
sentences.translation: Patnisni duxovkadan **olayotib** qo'lingni kuydirib oldingmi?

sentences.text: Oliver broke his arm **trying** to climb over a wall.
sentences.translation: Oliver devordan oshib o'tishga **urinayotib** qo'lini sindirib oldi.

sentences.text: **While waiting** for the bus, Nilufar read the first chapter of her new book.
sentences.translation: Avtobusni **kutayotib**, Nilufar yangi kitobining birinchi bobini o'qib chiqdi.

sentences.text: Please switch off the lights **when leaving** the room.
sentences.translation: Xonadan **chiqayotganda** chiroqni o'chiring.

sentences.text: Jasur got sunburnt **working** in the fields all day without a hat.
sentences.translation: Jasur kun bo'yi dalada shlyapasiz **ishlab**, quyoshda kuyib qoldi.

sentences.text: The firefighter injured his back **rescuing** a family from a burning house.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchi yonayotgan uydan bir oilani **qutqarayotib** belini shikastladi.

examples.title: One after another: **Opening** the door, she ...
examples.description: Ketma-ket harakatlar: birinchi harakat -ing bilan — «-ib». Odatda qisqa harakat va darhol keyingisi.

sentences.text: **Taking** a deep breath, Dilnoza walked onto the stage.
sentences.translation: Chuqur nafas **olib**, Dilnoza sahnaga chiqdi.

sentences.text: **Opening** the fridge, Tom realised that someone had eaten his lunch.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichni **ochib**, Tom kimdir tushligini yeb qo'yganini tushundi.

sentences.text: **Putting** on his coat, Bekzod rushed out to catch the last bus.
sentences.translation: Paltosini **kiyib**, Bekzod oxirgi avtobusga ulgurish uchun yugurib chiqdi.

sentences.text: The man jumped out of the car, **leaving** the engine running.
sentences.translation: Erkak dvigatelni **o'chirmay qoldirib**, mashinadan sakrab tushdi.

sentences.text: **Switching** off the computer, Jasur stood up and stretched.
sentences.translation: Kompyuterni **o'chirib**, Jasur o'rnidan turdi va kerishdi.

sentences.text: **Arriving** at the hotel, we found that our room wasn't ready.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga **yetib kelganimizda** xonamiz hali tayyor emasligi ma'lum bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Turning** the corner, Madina saw the old house where she was born.
sentences.translation: Muyulishdan **burilib**, Madina o'zi tug'ilgan eski uyni ko'rdi.

sentences.text: **Picking** up the phone, Oliver dialled his mother's number.
sentences.translation: Telefonni **olib**, Oliver onasining raqamini terdi.

sentences.text: **Finishing** his tea quickly, Grandpa went out to meet the guests.
sentences.translation: Choyini shoshib **ichib bo'lib**, bobom mehmonlarni kutib olgani chiqdi.

sentences.text: She handed me the keys, **saying** that she would be back on Monday.
sentences.translation: U dushanba kuni qaytishini **aytib**, kalitlarni menga berdi.

examples.title: **Having done**: the first action is finished
examples.description: having + V3 — birinchi harakat to'liq tugagach, ikkinchisi boshlandi: «-gach», «...b bo'lgach». After / before + -ing ham shunday.

sentences.text: **Having finished** his report, Aziz sent it to his manager and went home.
sentences.translation: Hisobotini **tugatgach**, Aziz uni menejeriga yubordi va uyiga ketdi.

sentences.text: **Having spent** all their money in London, the students had to go home early.
sentences.translation: Londonda bor pulini **sarflab bo'lgach**, talabalar uyga erta qaytishga majbur bo'lishdi.

sentences.text: Kate assembled the bookcase in an hour, **having read** the instructions carefully.
sentences.translation: Ko'rsatmalarni diqqat bilan **o'qib chiqqach**, Keyt kitob javonini bir soatda yig'ib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: **After checking** in at the hotel, we went straight to the Registan.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga **joylashgach**, to'g'ri Registonga bordik.

sentences.text: The team flew back to Manchester, **having won** the cup in Madrid.
sentences.translation: Madridda kubokni **qo'lga kiritgach**, jamoa Manchesterga uchib qaytdi.

sentences.text: Madina left the office at six, **having answered** every email in her inbox.
sentences.translation: Pochtasidagi barcha xatlarga **javob berib bo'lgach**, Madina soat oltida ofisdan chiqdi.

sentences.text: **Before leaving** the flat, Jasur checked that the gas was off.
sentences.translation: Kvartiradan **chiqishdan oldin** Jasur gaz o'chiqligini tekshirdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod went back to work only **after recovering** completely from the flu.
sentences.translation: Bekzod grippdan butunlay **tuzalgandan keyingina** ishga qaytdi.

sentences.text: Oliver applied for the job, **having heard** about it from a friend.
sentences.translation: Bu ish haqida do'stidan **eshitgach**, Oliver unga ariza topshirdi.

sentences.text: **Having said** goodbye to everyone, Nilufar got into the taxi with tears in her eyes.
sentences.translation: Hamma bilan **xayrlashgach**, Nilufar ko'zlarida yosh bilan taksiga o'tirdi.

examples.title: Reason: **Feeling** tired, **Being** a student
examples.description: -ing qismi sababni bildiradi — «...gani uchun»: feeling, being, knowing, living, wanting, hoping. Rasmiyroq uslub.

sentences.text: **Feeling** unwell, Sarah left the meeting early.
sentences.translation: **Mazasi qochgani uchun** Sara yig'ilishdan erta ketdi.

sentences.text: **Being** a nurse, Dilnoza knew exactly what to do after the accident.
sentences.translation: Hamshira **bo'lgani uchun** Dilnoza avariyadan keyin nima qilish kerakligini aniq bilardi.

sentences.text: **Knowing** how much his mother loved roses, Aziz planted twenty bushes in her garden.
sentences.translation: Onasi atirgulni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rishini **bilgani uchun** Aziz uning bog'iga yigirma tup ekdi.

sentences.text: **Living** so close to the office, I never need to take the metro.
sentences.translation: Ofisga juda yaqin **yashaganim uchun** metroga chiqishimga hech hojat yo'q.

sentences.text: **Hoping** to find a better job, Bekzod moved to the capital.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiroq ish **topish umidida** Bekzod poytaxtga ko'chib o'tdi.

sentences.text: **Wanting** to surprise his wife, Tom secretly booked a weekend in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Xotinini **hayratda qoldirmoqchi bo'lib**, Tom Edinburgga yashirincha dam olish safari band qildi.

sentences.text: **Being** only seventeen, Jasur isn't allowed to drive yet.
sentences.translation: Atigi o'n yetti **yoshda bo'lgani uchun** Jasurga hali mashina haydashga ruxsat yo'q.

sentences.text: **Thinking** that the shop was still open, Kate ran across the square.
sentences.translation: Do'kon hali ochiq **deb o'ylab**, Keyt maydondan yugurib o'tdi.

sentences.text: **Speaking** fluent English and Russian, Madina got a job at the embassy.
sentences.translation: Ingliz va rus tillarida ravon **gapirgani uchun** Madina elchixonaga ishga kirdi.

sentences.text: **Feeling** homesick, Oliver called his family in Manchester every evening.
sentences.translation: **Uyini sog'ingani uchun** Oliver har kuni kechqurun Manchesterdagi oilasiga qo'ng'iroq qilardi.

examples.title: Negative: **Not knowing**, **Not having**
examples.description: Inkor sabab: not + -ing — «...magani uchun», «...may». Not -ing qismi asosiy gapdan keyin ham kelishi mumkin.

sentences.text: **Not knowing** the way, we had to ask a policeman for directions.
sentences.translation: Yo'lni **bilmaganimiz uchun** politsiyachidan so'rashga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: **Not having** enough money for a taxi, Madina walked home.
sentences.translation: Taksiga puli **yetmagani uchun** Madina uyiga piyoda qaytdi.

sentences.text: **Not wanting** to wake the baby, Tom took off his shoes at the door.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloqni **uyg'otib yubormaslik uchun** Tom eshik oldida poyabzalini yechdi.

sentences.text: Aziz stood at the door, **not knowing** what to say.
sentences.translation: Aziz nima deyishni **bilmay**, eshik oldida turib qoldi.

sentences.text: Kate didn't call the police, **not wanting** to make the situation worse.
sentences.translation: Vaziyatni **yomonlashtirishni istamay**, Keyt politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.

sentences.text: The students sat in silence, **not understanding** a word of the lecture.
sentences.translation: Talabalar ma'ruzadan bir og'iz ham **tushunmay**, jim o'tirishdi.

sentences.text: Many people, **not realising** how dangerous the river is, swim there in summer.
sentences.translation: Ko'p odamlar daryo qanchalik xavfli ekanini **anglamay**, yozda u yerda cho'milishadi.

sentences.text: Jasur left the party early, **not feeling** in the mood for dancing.
sentences.translation: Raqsga tushishga **kayfiyati bo'lmagani uchun** Jasur ziyofatdan erta ketdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod watched the parade on TV, **not being** a big fan of crowds.
sentences.translation: Olomonni unchalik **yoqtirmagani uchun** Bekzod paradni televizorda tomosha qildi.

sentences.text: Sarah accepted the offer immediately, **not wishing** to lose such a great opportunity.
sentences.translation: Bunday ajoyib imkoniyatni **qo'ldan boy bermaslik uchun** Sara taklifni darhol qabul qildi.

examples.title: Reason with **Having** + V3: Having lived there, ...
examples.description: Sabab — oldinroq bo'lgan ish: having + V3 — «...gani uchun», «...b bo'lgani uchun». Inkor: not having + V3.

sentences.text: **Having lived** in Tashkent for ten years, James knows the city better than I do.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda o'n yil **yashagani uchun** Jeyms shaharni mendan yaxshiroq biladi.

sentences.text: **Having seen** the film twice already, Dilnoza decided to stay at home.
sentences.translation: Filmni allaqachon ikki marta **ko'rgani uchun** Dilnoza uyda qolishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: **Not having** studied for the test, Oliver wasn't surprised by his low mark.
sentences.translation: Testga **tayyorlanmagani uchun** Oliver past bahosidan ajablanmadi.

sentences.text: Kate easily found the hotel, **having been** to Edinburgh many times before.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda ilgari ko'p marta **bo'lgani uchun** Keyt mehmonxonani osongina topdi.

sentences.text: **Having missed** the last train, we had to spend the night at the station.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi poyezdga **ulgurmay qolganimiz uchun** tunni vokzalda o'tkazishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Aziz felt confident in the interview, **having prepared** for weeks.
sentences.translation: Haftalab **tayyorlangani uchun** Aziz suhbatda o'zini ishonchli his qildi.

sentences.text: The company, **having lost** its biggest client, had to cut jobs.
sentences.translation: Eng yirik mijozini **yo'qotgani uchun** kompaniya ish o'rinlarini qisqartirishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Madina didn't want to watch the match, **having heard** the score on the radio.
sentences.translation: Hisobni radiodan **eshitib qo'ygani uchun** Madina o'yinni ko'rishni istamadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod knows a lot about cars, **having worked** as a mechanic for years.
sentences.translation: Yillar davomida mexanik bo'lib **ishlagani uchun** Bekzod mashinalar haqida ko'p narsa biladi.

sentences.text: Jasur, **not having** received any reply, sent the email again.
sentences.translation: Hech qanday javob **olmagani uchun** Jasur xatni qaytadan yubordi.

examples.title: Mixed: news reports and stories
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bir vaqtdagi, ketma-ket va sabab ma'nosidagi -ing qismlari — yangiliklar va hikoyalar uslubida.

sentences.text: Two climbers were injured **trying** to reach the summit in bad weather.
sentences.translation: Ikki alpinist yomon havoda cho'qqiga **chiqishga urinayotib** jarohatlandi.

sentences.text: **Having won** the election, the new mayor promised to build more parks.
sentences.translation: Saylovda **g'alaba qozongach**, yangi hokim ko'proq bog' qurishni va'da qildi.

sentences.text: **Realising** she had left her passport at home, Emma took a taxi back.
sentences.translation: Pasportini uyda qoldirganini **anglab**, Emma taksida ortga qaytdi.

sentences.text: The fans waited outside the hotel for hours, **hoping** to see the players.
sentences.translation: Muxlislar futbolchilarni **ko'rish umidida** mehmonxona oldida soatlab kutishdi.

sentences.text: **Not having** any experience, Bekzod was surprised to get the job.
sentences.translation: Hech qanday **tajribasi bo'lmagani uchun** Bekzod ishga olinganidan hayron bo'ldi.

sentences.text: A woman fell asleep **driving** on the motorway and crashed into a barrier.
sentences.translation: Bir ayol avtomagistralda mashina **haydayotib** uxlab qoldi va to'siqqa urilib ketdi.

sentences.text: **Being** a small city, Khiva is easy to explore on foot in one day.
sentences.translation: Kichik shahar **bo'lgani uchun** Xivani bir kunda piyoda aylanib chiqish oson.

sentences.text: **Coming** out of the cinema, we bumped into our old maths teacher.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatrdan **chiqayotib**, eski matematika o'qituvchimizni uchratib qoldik.

sentences.text: The minister left without speaking to journalists, **refusing** to answer any questions.
sentences.translation: Vazir hech qanday savolga **javob berishdan bosh tortib**, jurnalistlar bilan gaplashmasdan chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: **Having worked** abroad for years, Dilnoza returned to Samarkand to open her own clinic.
sentences.translation: Yillar davomida chet elda **ishlagach**, Dilnoza o'z klinikasini ochish uchun Samarqandga qaytdi.
